newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Arranger group forms for Henderson loan.
newsitem.headline: Arranger group forms for Henderson loan.

text.p: Henderson Land Development Co Ltd has formed an arranger group for its revolving credit facility, bankers said on Tuesday.
They said the facility has been oversubscribed and increased to HK$4.8 billion from HK$3.0 billion in the underwriting stage.
Fifteen international banks have joined as arrangers and each will underwrite HK$320 million.
The facility carries a maturity of five years and pays a margin of 48.5 basis points over the Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for arrangers is 57 basis points.

Arrangers are Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi, Banque Nationale de Paris, Bayerische Landesbank, Chase Manhattan Asia, Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank, Dresdner Bank, Fuji Bank, J.P. Morgan Securities Asia, NatWest Markets, Sakura Bank, Sanwa Bank, Societe Generale Asia, Sumitomo Bank, Union Bank of Switzerland and Westdeutsche Landesbank.
Bankers said general syndication of the facility will begin shortly.
